entries.title: Revert relay-signed workflow attributed-author gate
entries.rationale: Reject because this revert removes the fail-closed relay-signed workflow attribution gate, deletes its strict tag/signature validation and regression tests, and restores the known failure where scheduled relay-signed workflow messages are dropped by owner-only agents. Retain the prior Zion security fix or implement an equivalent authenticated owner-provenance design.
security_reasons: removes local signature verification for the exemption
removes regression tests and restores workflow wake-up failure
verification: Full-SHA diff reviewed; relay-signed workflow messages remain subject to direct event-author gating after the revert, while workflow execution-side owner/member checks remain separate. No source implementation made.
